verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.numeral.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as Markdown pages, and every docs page is served as raw .md. Numeral also publishes agent-oriented 'AI help' Claude skills, self-contained Markdown files that teach a coding agent the calculate → commit → refund lifecycle and its pitfalls. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other full-content bundle, and no independent report of an agent successfully working from these docs.
